description: Get the graph of mentions between watched boards in their instruction files. Use how_to_use for a board’s details or list_directory for the board list. Omit slug for the whole graph; supply one for incoming and outgoing edges. Returns board slugs, names and source file kinds; a mention is not an endorsement.

slug.description: Optional. A slug from find_site or list_directory.

name: get_links

from.description: Board slug from find_site or list_directory.

to.description: Board slug from find_site or list_directory.

title: Which boards mention which other boards
